description: This header file defines functions and data structures for utility operations related to command execution and monitoring within the Cuttlefish Android emulator project. It includes declarations for reading exit codes, retrieving launcher monitors, reading launcher actions, and executing launcher actions over socket connections.
external_methods: Result<SharedFD> GetLauncherMonitorFromInstance(const CuttlefishConfig::InstanceSpecific& instance_config, const int timeout_seconds)
Result<SharedFD> GetLauncherMonitor(const CuttlefishConfig& config, int instance_num, int timeout_seconds)
Result<void> RunLauncherAction(SharedFD monitor_socket, LauncherAction action, std::optional<int> timeout_seconds)
Result<void> RunLauncherAction(SharedFD monitor_socket, const run_cvd::ExtendedLauncherAction& extended_action, std::optional<int> timeout_seconds)

classes.name: LauncherActionInfo
classes.description: A structure holding launcher actions and their extended form, used for communication over sockets.

methods.name: ReadExitCode
methods.description: Reads the exit code from the monitor socket.

methods.name: GetLauncherMonitorFromInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a monitor socket for a specific instance based on configuration, with a timeout.

methods.name: GetLauncherMonitor
methods.description: Retrieves the monitor socket for a specific launcher instance specified by the configuration and instance number.

methods.name: ReadLauncherActionFromFd
methods.description: Reads launcher action information from a socket, returning optional details.

methods.name: WaitForRead
methods.description: Waits for data to be available to read on the monitor socket within a specified timeout.

methods.name: RunLauncherAction
methods.description: Sends a launcher action request over a socket and waits for completion, handling extended actions as well.
